title: SCAN-Resources: Instruments and Training Datasets for the Synthetic Cognitive Augmentation Network
description: Resources for the Synthetic Cognitive Augmentation Network (SCAN): the SCANAQ alignment questionnaire (instrument 2.0.0) and its scoring model (2.0.0), the CAUSE user survey, a generation prompt for synthetic training dialogues, and JSONL training/validation datasets for five prefrontal-cortex-simulating agents (DLPFC, VMPFC, OFC, ACC, MPFC). See CHANGELOG.md for version history and PROVENANCE.md for item-source attributions.
